name: Permit.io Community
free_limit: 1,000 monthly active users; 20 tenants; unlimited authorization queries; 3 environments; 25 roles
watch_out: Community is Free Forever for up to 1,000 MAU and 20 tenants. The 14-day audit-log retention advertised on the provider's payment comparison is a Pro feature, not a verified Community allowance; do not assume it is included in Free. Enterprise compliance, SSO and premium support require separate terms. Commercial-use rights remain unconfirmed.
